description: This file defines the GDPR email controller class for the OpenCart admin system. It handles exporting, approving, removing, and denying GDPR-related data, and includes methods for composing and sending related emails, as well as processing customer data and order information.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for handling GDPR-related email actions within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main controller method handling incoming requests, fetching GDPR info, deciding which action to perform (export, approve, remove, deny), and calling the respective methods.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Generates and sends a GDPR export email including customer info, addresses, orders, and IP data.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves GDPR data and sends approval email.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes GDPR data associated with a customer.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Deny GDPR request (currently only a placeholder).
